content.en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms, specifically neural networks and genetic algorithms, to optimize the design of aerodynamic structures such as nozzles and airfoils. By combining these algorithms with computational fluid dynamics and other techniques, they aim to improve the efficiency and performance of these structures. Machine learning techniques, including deep neural networks and Gaussian processes, are also being used to reduce computational time and enhance data efficiency in aerodynamic design optimization.
content.da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer, specifikt neurale netværk og genetiske algoritmer, for at optimere designet af aerodynamiske strukturer såsom dyser og profiler. Ved at kombinere disse algoritmer med computational fluid dynamics og andre teknikker sigter de mod at forbedre effektiviteten og ydeevnen af disse strukturer. Maskinlæringsteknikker, herunder dybe neurale netværk og Gaussian processes, benyttes også til at reducere beregningstiden og forbedre dataeffektiviteten i optimering af aerodynamisk design.

critic.en: This obsession with efficiency and performance optimization in engineering and design only exacerbates the existing environmental and social problems caused by these disciplines. The planet can’t afford more “optimized” cars, planes, and industrial processes. These are the very sources of pollution and destruction we should be questioning, not replicating.
critic.da: Neural netværk og genetiske algoritmer til at designe mere effektive fly? Det lyder vanvittigt, og det er nemlig præcis min pointe. Hvorfor overlade vores fremtid til maskiner? Vi riskerer at miste kontrol over kritiske samfundsstrukturer.

potential.en: This is such an exciting avenue of research! The potential for using algorithms to optimize aerodynamic design is vast, and the combination of different techniques such as neural networks and genetic algorithms can lead to significant improvements in efficiency and performance. I find it fascinating to see how machine learning is being applied to reduce computational time and make the design process more efficient. I'm excited to see the future advancements in this field!
potential.da: Det er en rigtig spændende udvikling! Kombinationen af maskinlæring og aerodynamisk design åbner op for helt nye muligheder for at forbedre effektiviteten i luftfartsindustrien. Det er fantastisk at se, hvordan teknologien kan bruges til at reducere miljøpåvirkningen og styrke konkurrenceevnen. Jeg ser stor potentiale i dette område og ser frem til at følge udviklingen!
